method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: B146 textual review closed on 1c941a7a with independent blind Claude (claude-opus-5.5) and GPT (gpt-6.1-sol) reviews of 38833c7f; six fix commits followed, mostly on the 牧 exclusion list where the two families disagreed on 僧 and 坊, and the final confirmations of 1c941a7a (both reviewers) were run by fresh agents of the same families. Disclosed limits: no JDK, so the Android JVM tests were not run; scope audits do not attribute shell and Python reads; two prompts were recovered from the runtime session record; the 僧 and 牧 judgments rest partly on live Weblio text; the reading audits are Python ports without a Kotlin cross-check.
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

10 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards, counted per quiz prompt; nine distinct card-and-reading pairs) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 牧 ま (摩 磨 馬 魔), まい (埋 妹 枚 毎 米) and もく (木 目), 狂 ふれる (触), 狭 せ (瀬 背), 甚 じ (路) and いたい (痛), 益 よう (妖 容 幼 揚 曜 栄 様 洋 and 9 more), 盛 もり (守 森; one pair, counted for both the も.る and さか.る prompts).

No KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option in the checked pools, and no one-holder Starter case exists. The first gate run showed a one-holder padded hit for 盛 (もり, offered by 森), because the original distractors 戦 式 店 held only one Starter card and left slots to the random fallback; they were replaced by the Starter cards 山 海 店, which fill every slot.
3 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (煮る, 矛盾, 不潔) are pre-existing and out of scope: each line wraps, so the entry id is on the next line.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Eight cards quiz only their on reading (熟 ジュク, 牧 ボク, 献 ケン and コン, 玄 ゲン, 環 カン, 益 エキ, 盾 ジュン, 睡 スイ) and seven only their kun reading (煮 に.る, 狂 くる.う, 狭 せま.い, 甚 はなは.だ, 癖 くせ, 盛 も.る and さか.る, 眺 なが.める).
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.
Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they list cards and other files as unread that the reports say were read; the later confirmations covered only the changed lines and the cumulative change.
The 牧 exclusion judgments of the last rounds rest partly on Digital Daijisen text read live on Weblio, not on a pinned copy in the packet.
The prompts of confirm3-gpt and confirm4-claude were given inline and recovered from the runtime session record, not from saved files.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
